# PW_TC_CW

## Summary

WordPress implementation of the Dinajpur Institute of Science & Technology public site.

## Frontend

- Active theme: wp-content/themes/dist-faithful
- Reference site: https://distdinajpur.edu.bd/
- The theme preserves the reference HTML structure and imports the reference CSS, JavaScript, fonts, logos, and gallery images.

## Backend

- Plugin: wp-content/plugins/pew-site-core
- Content types include notices, courses, staff, results, documents, gallery items, and events.
- WordPress pages hold copied public page content.
- pew_student and pew_teacher roles use the private dashboard shortcode.

## Local commands

~~~bash
bash scripts/prepare-wordpress.sh
bash scripts/serve-wordpress.sh
~~~

The local fast-browse URL is normally http://127.0.0.1:8090/; the server script reports a fallback port if needed.

## Sensitive files

.env, wp-config.php, runtime logs, uploads, caches, and local generated artifacts are not repository content.
